title: The State Of Chinese AI
gist: Gavekal argues China's AI ecosystem is impressive but not positioned to overtake the US even if the American AI bubble pops, assessing open-weight models, data, electricity and talent.

insights.claim: Last week brought doubts about frontier labs' revenue growth and the rising high-priced debt financing US data-center building.
insights.speaker: Arthur Kroeber
insights.so_what: US AI financing risk is now a market concern.

insights.claim: Even if US labs and hyperscalers hit serious speed bumps, China probably cannot race ahead and is not positioned to overtake the US any time soon.
insights.speaker: Arthur Kroeber
insights.so_what: An AI-bubble pop in the US should not be read as a China AI win.

insights.claim: The note judges China's AI industry on four features: the open-weight ecosystem, data, electricity and talent, with strengths in all areas but mostly still playing catch-up.
insights.speaker: Arthur Kroeber
insights.so_what: A four-factor lens for comparing national AI competitiveness.
